summary: Worked all 13 client-side (WSTG-CLNT) items on shop.lab.test (HTTP only). Key finding — Reflected XSS / HTML injection (items 2, 3): GET /search.php?q= reflects the raw query string into the HTML body with no escaping. A literal payload x7test and are both echoed verbatim into text/html, confirming attacker-controlled script executes in a victim browser. Recorded as a high lead (amplified by the non-HttpOnly session cookie noted by the auth lane). Clickjacking (item 9): homepage, /login and the authenticated /account/settings (change-password form) are served with no X-Frame-Options and no CSP frame-ancestors — all framable. Recorded as a medium lead. Not vulnerable / nothing found (tested, marked done): DOM-based XSS (item 1) — the only client script app.js and its sourcemap use fetch() to fixed paths with no DOM sinks; client-side URL redirect (item 4) — /login?next= not reflected/honored, no location sink in JS; CSS injection (item 5) — no style-context sink; client-side resource manipulation (item 6) — resources loaded only from hardcoded paths; CORS (item 7) — no Access-Control-Allow-Origin returned for cross-origin Origin on /api/v1/items and /api/v1/orders; web messaging (item 11) — no postMessage/message listeners; browser storage (item 12) — no localStorage/sessionStorage, session held in cookie (already flagged by other lanes); XSSI (item 13) — /api/v1/orders returns a plain JSON object and ignores a callback param. N/A: cross-site flashing (item 8) — no Flash/SWF content; WebSockets (item 10) — no WebSocket usage. All items done or N/A; nothing left open. All testing was read-only (writes not permitted in this engagement).
